body_md:
**Henry VIII** broke away from the Church of Rome and set up the Church of England. He had six wives. His daughter **Elizabeth I** defeated the **Spanish Armada** in 1588. William Shakespeare was born in Stratford-upon-Avon in 1564.

In 1603 James VI of Scotland also became James I of England. **Charles I** fought Parliament in the **Civil War** (Cavaliers against Roundheads) and was executed in 1649. Oliver Cromwell ruled as Lord Protector.

The monarchy returned in 1660. The Great Fire of London was in 1666. In 1688 the **Glorious Revolution** brought William of Orange to the throne, and in **1707** the Act of Union created Great Britain.
key_facts: 1707: Act of Union creates Great Britain
